correctness.rationale: For internally disjoint terminal paths, two orientations have equal indegree parity precisely when their differing edges are an even union of whole paths. The fiber size 2^(m-1) follows. Acyclicity is equivalent to all coherent paths pointing the same way; a proper coherent subset gives 2 times the product of (2^(length-1)-1) parity classes, each with the exact 2-power number of acyclic representatives. Fully coherent paths produce the two parity orbits and parity-dependent 2z versus 1+z^2. All boundary cases m>=3 and each path length>=2 are included. Independent of the formula, an executable enumeration checked 30 graphs and 159168 orientations. This finite check supplements, not replaces, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The full fiber spectrum determines how many feasible parity prescriptions have each possible multiplicity of acyclic realizing orientations on a natural infinite series-parallel graph family with overlapping cycles. It refines both existence feasibility and total orientation enumeration, including a binomial specialization for K_{2,m}. The sole no-source obstruction for even width is known; the value is the complete nontrivial multiplicity spectrum, not that obstruction alone.
